def snap():
    d={'c':[],'O':[],'N':[],'G':[],'b':[]}
    for n in current_frame.segmentation['nodes']:
        r0=min(p[0] for p in n['boundary'])//4; c0=min(p[1] for p in n['boundary'])//4
        if r0>=14: continue
        if n['color']=='c' and n['pixels']==12: d['c'].append((r0,c0))
        if n['color']=='O': d['O'].append((r0,c0))
        if n['color']=='N': d['N'].append((r0,c0))
        if n['color']=='G': d['G'].append((r0,c0))
        if n['color']=='b' and n['pixels']<=8: d['b'].append((r0,c0))
    return d
action(['DOWN','DOWN']); print('DD',snap())
for i in range(8):
    action(['LEFT'])
print('L8',snap())
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
